main.description: Publicly lists indexed contributor-information records with an optional publisher-DID filter and stable createdAt ordering.

authors.description: Publisher repository DIDs; values use OR.

sortDirection.description: Direction for (createdAt, uri); defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum records in the page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An author DID, sort direction, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ContributorInformationQueryFailed
errors.description: The record query or required publisher hydration lookup failed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
